citation: Jovanovic et al. (2015), Science 347, 1259038, Figure 1 and GEO series GSE59792
preparation: Mock-treated mouse bone marrow-derived dendritic cells
unit: Relative iBAQ signal, scaled to a proteome-wide medium plus heavy total of one million per sample
observable: Heavy signal divided by the paired heavy and medium sum within each replicate. The light spike supplies the shared reference. Recycling can place medium amino acids in newly produced protein.
